d.ko: A delivery guy. A dimensional rift. A quest across another world. Master telekinesis and elemental magic in Erath, where everyday objects become legendary weapons. Battle mythical creatures. Solve ancient puzzles. Uncover dark truths. Advanced VR physics meet epic fantasy adventure.

d.zh: 一名快递员。一道次元裂缝。一场史诗任务。在Erath掌握念力和元素魔法。对抗神话生物。解开古老谜题。先进VR物理引擎与史诗奇幻冒险的完美结合。
